</script>
<script id="biomaps-addon-script">
(()=>{
  "use strict";
  const openButton=document.getElementById('biomaps-open');
  const closeButton=document.getElementById('biomaps-close');
  const modal=document.getElementById('biomaps-modal');
  const frame=document.getElementById('biomaps-frame');
  const loading=document.getElementById('biomaps-loading');
  let initialized=false;
  let htmlCache=null;
  function extractHtml(){
    if(htmlCache)return htmlCache;
    const payload=document.getElementById('biomaps-embedded-html').textContent.trim();
    const binary=atob(payload);
    const bytes=new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for(let i=0;i<binary.length;i++)bytes[i]=binary.charCodeAt(i);
    htmlCache=new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);
    return htmlCache;
  }
  function open(){
    if(!initialized){
      frame.addEventListener('load',()=>{loading.hidden=true},{once:true});
      frame.srcdoc=extractHtml();
      initialized=true;
    }
    modal.hidden=false;closeButton.focus();
    setTimeout(()=>{if(!modal.hidden&&!loading.hidden){loading.textContent='إذا ما ظهرت الخرائط، اضغط «فتح مستقل» بالأعلى.';}},10000);
  }
  function close(){modal.hidden=true;openButton.focus();}
  openButton.addEventListener('click',open);
  document.getElementById('biomaps-new-tab').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const page=new Blob([extractHtml()],{type:'text/html;charset=utf-8'});
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(page);
    const win=window.open(url,'_blank');
    if(win)win.opener=null;
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),120000);
  });
  closeButton.addEventListener('click',close);
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
    if(!modal.hidden && e.key==='Escape'){
      e.preventDefault();close();
    }
  });
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
